newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newbridge Networks started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newbridge Networks started.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Farrokh Billimoria has started coverage of Newbridge Networks Corp with a buy rating based on new products and a strong core business.
-- In a statement, Billimoria said Newbridge is well-positioned to take advanatage of new network switching devices based on Frame Relay technology.
-- He also said the company's lead in technology called time division multiplexer (TDM), which is currently being revitalized, enhances Newbridge's growth prospects.
-- Billimoria expects the company to earn US$1.09 a share in fiscal 1997, rising to US$1.39 in fiscal 1998.
